name: LIMIT_BAL
description: Amount of credit given (individual + family/supplementary credit)

name: SEX
description: 1 = male, 2 = female

name: EDUCATION
description: 1 = graduate school, 2 = university, 3 = high school, 4 = others (raw codes 0/5/6 recoded to 4)

name: MARRIAGE
description: 1 = married, 2 = single, 3 = others (raw code 0 recoded to 3)

name: AGE
description: Age in years (21–79)

name: PAY_1
description: Repayment status in Sep 2005: −2 no consumption, −1 paid in full, 0 revolving credit / minimum paid, k ≥ 1 = payment k months late (UCI name PAY_0)

name: PAY_2
description: Repayment status in Aug 2005: −2 no consumption, −1 paid in full, 0 revolving credit / minimum paid, k ≥ 1 = payment k months late (UCI name PAY_2)

name: PAY_3
description: Repayment status in Jul 2005: −2 no consumption, −1 paid in full, 0 revolving credit / minimum paid, k ≥ 1 = payment k months late (UCI name PAY_3)

name: PAY_4
description: Repayment status in Jun 2005: −2 no consumption, −1 paid in full, 0 revolving credit / minimum paid, k ≥ 1 = payment k months late (UCI name PAY_4)

name: PAY_5
description: Repayment status in May 2005: −2 no consumption, −1 paid in full, 0 revolving credit / minimum paid, k ≥ 1 = payment k months late (UCI name PAY_5)

name: PAY_6
description: Repayment status in Apr 2005: −2 no consumption, −1 paid in full, 0 revolving credit / minimum paid, k ≥ 1 = payment k months late (UCI name PAY_6)

name: BILL_AMT1
description: Bill statement amount in Sep 2005 (negative = credit balance)

name: BILL_AMT2
description: Bill statement amount in Aug 2005 (negative = credit balance)

name: BILL_AMT3
description: Bill statement amount in Jul 2005 (negative = credit balance)

name: BILL_AMT4
description: Bill statement amount in Jun 2005 (negative = credit balance)

name: BILL_AMT5
description: Bill statement amount in May 2005 (negative = credit balance)

name: BILL_AMT6
description: Bill statement amount in Apr 2005 (negative = credit balance)

name: PAY_AMT1
description: Amount paid in Sep 2005 (previous payment)

name: PAY_AMT2
description: Amount paid in Aug 2005 (previous payment)

name: PAY_AMT3
description: Amount paid in Jul 2005 (previous payment)

name: PAY_AMT4
description: Amount paid in Jun 2005 (previous payment)

name: PAY_AMT5
description: Amount paid in May 2005 (previous payment)

name: PAY_AMT6
description: Amount paid in Apr 2005 (previous payment)

name: UTIL_1
description: Credit utilisation, latest month: BILL_AMT1 / LIMIT_BAL

name: UTIL_MEAN
description: Mean utilisation over 6 months: mean(BILL_AMT1..6) / LIMIT_BAL

name: PAY_RATIO_MEAN
description: Mean of PAY_AMTk / BILL_AMTk over months with a positive bill, clipped to [0, 5]; 0 if no positive bill

name: N_MONTHS_DELAYED
description: Number of the 6 months with a payment delay (PAY_k > 0)

name: MAX_DELAY
description: Worst repayment status over the 6 months: max(PAY_1..6) clipped at 0

name: BILL_TREND
description: Balance growth relative to limit: (BILL_AMT1 − BILL_AMT6) / LIMIT_BAL

name: DEFAULT
description: 1 = defaulted on the payment due in October 2005, 0 = paid (UCI name 'default payment next month')
